# heraut version sprint

Sprint counter management.

Manage the sprint counter (versioning.sprint in .heraut.yml) of CalVer formats that contain SPRINT.

## Usage

```text
heraut version sprint [command]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut version sprint bump
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |

## Subcommands

- [heraut version sprint bump](heraut_version_sprint_bump.md): Increment versioning.sprint in .heraut.yml
